Here is the complete test suite for the requirements under test:

```python
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from your_module import Symptom, ConsultationRequest

class TestSymptoms(unittest.TestCase):

    def setUp(self):
        self.symptom = Symptom(description="Test Symptom")
        self.consultation_request = ConsultationRequest()

    def test_add_new_symptom(self):
        # Arrange
        new_symptom = Symptom(description="New Test Symptom")

        # Act
        self.symptom.add(new_symptom)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(self.symptom.get_all()), 2)
        self.assertEqual(self.symptom.get_all()[1].description, "New Test Symptom")

    def test_view_and_update_symptom(self):
        # Arrange
        self.symptom.description = "Updated Test Symptom"

        # Act
        updated_symptom = self.symptom.get_all()[0]

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(updated_symptom.description, "Updated Test Symptom")

    def test_delete_symptom(self):
        # Arrange
        self.consultation_request.add_symptom(self.symptom)

        # Act
        self.symptom.delete()

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(self.symptom.get_all()), 0)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.consultation_request.get_all_symptoms()), 0)

    def test_delete_symptom_with_consultation_request(self):
        # Arrange
        self.consultation_request.add_symptom(self.symptom)

        # Act
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.symptom.delete()

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(self.symptom.get_all()), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.consultation_request.get_all_symptoms()), 1)

    def test_delete_symptom_with_multiple_consultation_requests(self):
        # Arrange
        self.consultation_request.add_symptom(self.symptom)
        self.consultation_request2 = ConsultationRequest()
        self.consultation_request2.add_symptom(self.symptom)

        # Act
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.symptom.delete()

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(self.symptom.get_all()), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.consultation_request.get_all_symptoms()), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.consultation_request2.get_all_symptoms()), 1)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```
